errors: Only the host can close the room
Only the host can set state
maxClients must be a positive number

behaviours.why: A present-but-null `to` fails Number.isSafeInteger and answers "Target peer not found"; the E2E stub broadcasts it instead.
New joiners push to members.length, so indices grow monotonically and may exceed maxClients after churn.
A disconnect frees the cap, so a returning owner can be answered "Room is full".
peer_joined fires only when the slot was not already active, so a display replacing its own live socket is invisible to phones.
Slot 0 vanishing arms a timer that tears the whole room down and 4001s everyone.
party.pinInstance -> ttp_framing_pin_url and the display join URL's #instance fragment only run when these are non-empty.
setState(undefined) is refused, but an explicit null is RETAINED and replayed as a cleared-state signal.
The 16 KiB cap is UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 units, which is what makes the C++ round trip length-sensitive.
Every (re)joiner gets the host snapshot right after `joined`, which is how a phone recovers without a per-phone WELCOME.
A single malformed frame is a session-ending event in prod and a no-op in the E2E stub.
